headline: Alianza Trust Renda to Sell Real Estate Asset to Coca-Cola FEMSA for R$140M
summary: Real estate investment fund Alianza Trust Renda signed a commitment to sell a property in Santo André to its tenant, Coca-Cola FEMSA, for R$140 million, generating an extraordinary profit.
why: Real estate investment funds (FIIs) distribute portfolio gains to investors, making asset sales a direct driver of per-quota earnings.

impacts.name: Alianza Trust Renda FII
impacts.why: The asset sale creates an extraordinary profit distributed across quotas.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
